name: GWA World Championship
epitaph: Held by Tim Croft (7-5) at the league's own Week 11 count; never seen defended anywhere in this collection's own holdings, though the Tournament of Bruises' own winner is promised a shot at it within seven days.

name: GWA USA Championship
epitaph: Held by Dustin Haas (4-6) at the league's own Week 11 count; attested only on the rankings sheet itself.

name: GWA World TV Championship
epitaph: Held by Dread Saxon (6-6) at the league's own Week 11 count; like the USA title, attested only on the rankings sheet itself.

name: GWA World Tag Team Championship
epitaph: Held by the Power Force, Warrior816 and Ahmed Johnson (5-1) at Week 11, and still billed as reigning champions a month later on the Halloween in Hollywood card against a challenging team, Raging Heat, whose own members this collection cannot name.
